packageRules.description: openapi-typescript reaches into the TypeScript compiler API (ts.factory), which the TS 7 Go port does not expose, so `npm run gen:types` crashes at module load. openapi-typescript's latest (7.13.0) still declares peerDependencies.typescript ^5.x and no 8.x exists. Lift this cap once openapi-typescript ships TS 7 support; tracked in #93.
